nodes.label: history.js Module
nodes.rationale: Provides historical OHLCV candle retrieval from the TradingView History API.

nodes.label: FETCH_HISTORY Background Handler
nodes.rationale: Handles requests to fetch stock history in the background layer.

nodes.label: manifest.json
nodes.rationale: Declares MV3 permissions, service worker, popup side panel, content script, and web accessible resources.

nodes.label: background.js Service Worker
nodes.rationale: Owns alarm-based portfolio monitoring, Telegram notifications, TradingView proxy message handlers, and side panel behavior setup.

nodes.label: popup.html UI Shell
nodes.rationale: Contains the static UI shell and loads popup.js.

nodes.label: popup.js
nodes.rationale: Calls initApp(document) to initialize the popup or side panel UI.

nodes.label: app.js App Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Owns app state and orchestration, wires UI callbacks, refreshes prices every 30 seconds, recalculates summaries, checks alerts, and persists changes.

nodes.label: ui.js UI Layer
nodes.rationale: Renders and binds DOM under a supplied root so the same UI logic works in popup, side panel, and Shadow DOM widget contexts.

nodes.label: content-loader.js
nodes.rationale: Dynamically imports content.js and rewrites relative ES module imports to extension URLs for content-script usage.

nodes.label: content.js Floating Widget
nodes.rationale: Injects a Shadow DOM floating widget into arbitrary pages, reuses popup UI content, observes TradingView alert JSON snippets, and hides GoPro dialogs.

nodes.label: storage.js Persistence Abstraction
nodes.rationale: Centralizes chrome.storage.local access and preserves stable key names for user data compatibility.

nodes.label: price.js Market Data Module
nodes.rationale: Handles symbol lookup, deep research snapshots, ticker normalization, and TradingView scanner fetch/proxy behavior.

nodes.label: scanner_data.js Scanner Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Scans Vietnam stocks and crypto, then compresses records for AI to reduce prompt size.

nodes.label: scorer.js Local Pre-AI Scoring Engine
nodes.rationale: Ranks scanner results locally using confluence scoring before sending them to AI.

nodes.label: ai.js AI Integration
nodes.rationale: Supports Gemini and OpenAI providers, builds Vietnamese trading prompts, logs prompts/responses, and throws localized configuration errors.

nodes.label: utils.js Calculation Helpers
nodes.rationale: Provides price divisor, escaping, T0 math, R:R, markdown formatting, position sizing, candle pattern, probability, confluence score, and sector allocation helpers.

nodes.label: pnl.js PnL Calculations
nodes.rationale: Calculates trade-level and aggregate PnL.

nodes.label: analysis.js Technical Analysis
nodes.rationale: Provides Fibonacci levels and basic entry/exit suggestions from scanner snapshots.

nodes.label: telegram.js Telegram Integration
nodes.rationale: Wraps Telegram Bot API sendMessage using HTML parse mode.

nodes.label: history.js Historical Data Engine
nodes.rationale: Fetches historical OHLCV candle data for Price Action analysis.

nodes.label: calculateT0Scenario(trade, priceData)
nodes.rationale: Planned utility function to calculate T0 scenarios based on trade and price data.

nodes.label: Trading Portfolio Pro v2.0 Smart Strategist Plan
nodes.rationale: Upgrades the app with smart risk management, T0 cost-basis strategy, optimal entry/exit analyzer, and proactive AI assistant.

nodes.label: fetchScannerData()
nodes.rationale: Planned function to fetch Price, Volume, RSI, MACD, Change%, and Volatility from TradingView.

nodes.label: screenPotentialStocks(targetProfit)
nodes.rationale: Planned ai.js screener function for bundle-mode AI filtering.

nodes.label: Professional AI Advisor Engine
nodes.rationale: Tích hợp Prompt Advisor chuyên sâu để phân tích chi tiết từng mã cổ phiếu và đưa ra kế hoạch giao dịch cụ thể.

nodes.label: AI Advisor & Smart Screener
nodes.author: Hà PM (AWF 4.0)
nodes.rationale: Build stock opportunity screener and personalized AI advisor for Vietnam stock market using TradingView API and AI to produce Entry, Stoploss, Target plans.

nodes.label: Modern UI & Theme System Upgrade
nodes.rationale: Upgrade Trading Portfolio Pro UI with multi-theme system while preserving TradingView default identity and adding high-tech themes.

nodes.label: AI Advisor & Smart Screener Specification
nodes.rationale: System supports surfing investors in Vietnam by combining automated technical screening and AI for short-term profit candidates based on realtime data.

nodes.label: AI Deep Stock Research
nodes.rationale: Helps investors analyze one Vietnam stock comprehensively through AI combined with technical and fundamental data, reducing need to read long financial reports.

nodes.label: Zone Engine V3 Rule-based Trading System
nodes.rationale: Rule-based trading script covers resistance zone detection, capital management, and take-profit points to make workflow easier.

nodes.label: Hybrid Trading System V5
nodes.author: congtuuit
nodes.rationale: TradingView Pine Script v5 indicator for Stock, Crypto, Forex using 3-Layer Confluence Engine.

nodes.label: Hybrid Trading System V5.5
nodes.author: congtuuit
nodes.rationale: V5.5 adds SMC FVG, liquidity sweeps, ADX regime, smart position sizing, and standardized JSON webhook alerts.

nodes.label: Trading Portfolio Pro Popup
nodes.rationale: Chrome extension popup UI for portfolio management, advisor scanning, deep research, settings, history, DCA, and close-position workflows.

nodes.label: TradingView Logo Icon
nodes.rationale: Image file referenced as TradingView logo in popup header.
